item.title: Road Surface, 24th August
item.description:
Opposite where the bank was repaired on Badgeworth Lane, the road is cracking above the bank just before the bridge going from Reddings Farm towards The Reddings. Before crossing the bridge. The work to repair the bank was carried out last year. But the other side of the road is now being affected by the bank deteriorating, possibly due to the heat and dry weather over the last few months. Without attention, this could result in the road being closed again. We need to get ahead of this.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Badgeworth Road, Badgeworth, Tewkesbury

item.title: Vandalism on Kerbs, 24th August
item.description:
Hi, It looks like some Temu graffiti artist has gone around paint-rolling these yellow marks on the kerbs. It's clear that they're not official because they're unevenly-painted and the spacing between then has not been measured corroect, and is, instead, random. This is also the case on Clarence Road and Winchcome Street. In fact, these marks are appearing all over the town, so it seems that the vandal is quite prolific. Could you let me know when these will be removed and re-painted correctly, please?
